Do you see him coming? Vaulting the mountains, leaping the hills.
like a young stag, virile. Look at him there, on tiptoe at the gate, all ears, all eyes—ready!
and he's speaking to me! Get up, my dear friend, fair and beautiful lover—come to me!

The whole world's a choir—and singing! Spring warblers are filling the forest with sweet arpeggios.
and cherry trees fragrant with blossoms. Oh, get up, dear friend, my fair and beautiful lover—come to me!
leave your seclusion, come out in the open. Let me see your face, let me hear your voice. For your voice is soothing and your face is ravishing.
